1.w: A psalm; a song for the Sabbath day. It is fitting to thank the Lord, and to sing praises to your name, O Most High.

2.w: It is fitting to proclaim your loyal love in the morning and your faithfulness during the night,

3.w: to the accompaniment of a ten-stringed instrument and a lyre, to the accompaniment of the meditative tone of the harp.

4.w: For you, O Lord, have made me happy by your work. I will sing for joy because of what you have done.

5.w: How great are your works, O Lord! Your plans are very intricate!

6.w: The spiritually insensitive do not recognize this; the fool does not understand this.

7.w: When the wicked sprout up like grass, and all the evildoers glisten, it is so that they may be annihilated.

8.w: But you, O Lord, reign forever.

9.w: Indeed, look at your enemies, O Lord. Indeed, look at how your enemies perish. All the evildoers are scattered.

10.w: You exalt my horn like that of a wild ox. I am covered with fresh oil.

11.w: I gloat in triumph over those who tried to ambush me; I hear the defeated cries of the evil foes who attacked me.

12.w: The godly grow like a palm tree; they grow high like a cedar in Lebanon.

13.w: Planted in the Lord’s house, they grow in the courts of our God.

14.w: They bear fruit even when they are old; they are filled with vitality and have many leaves.

15.w: So they proclaim that the Lord, my Protector, is just and never unfair.
